title: Peninsula Summer Music Festival 2027, Save the Date
summary: Peninsula Summer Music Festival returns 2 to 10 January 2027. Program and tickets TBC. 2026 edition spanned 18 events at wineries, churches and outdoor venues.
suitableFor: Classical/jazz/contemporary music lovers; wine and culture visitors; couples
accessibilityNotes: Venues vary, some outdoor, some historic churches; PSMF accommodates accessibility needs on request
nearbyAttractions: Mornington Peninsula wineries; Peninsula Hot Springs; Flinders village
suggestedItineraryPairing: Multi-day festival stay; pair with cellar door visits and Peninsula Hot Springs
editorVerdict: Save-the-date for the festival that puts world-class chamber music inside a winery. Check the official festival site for program and ticket announcements.
editorNote:
The Peninsula Summer Music Festival has confirmed 2 to 10 January 2027 on its official site. Program, artists, venues and ticketing not yet released.

The 2026 edition ran 18 events across Flinders Civic Hall, Montalto, Port Phillip Estate, Peninsula Hot Springs and St John's Anglican Flinders, with classical at the centre and jazz and contemporary on the flanks (The Bamboos, Karin Schaupp, Ensemble Offspring, AYO Young Artists, Ensemble 642). Events were individually ticketed.

If you're a returning attendee, get on the festival mailing list now. If new, watch for the program announcement.
